goals: Verify that the /dna/simian API endpoint successfully returns a 200 status code when processing POST requests with DNA payloads under a variable load profile.
Ensure the total number of HTTP requests executed during the load test remains below the threshold of 1200.
activities: Initialize the HTTP request payload with a DNA sequence
Set the Content-Type header to application/json
Send an HTTP POST request to the simian API endpoint
Check if the HTTP response status code is 200
